title: Rav Nachman bar Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports Shmuel in Eruvin 34b and 80b. Eruvin 102 has Nachumi bar Ada, as does Beitzah 31b: Rav Nachumi bar Ada.
In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4, R' Yonah says, “Rav Nachman bar Ada taught.”[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The locators לד: פ: mean Eruvin 34b and 80b; קב, gives 102 without a definite folio side. These are Hyman’s references.
Hyman gives Nachman in the heading and Nachumi in the Eruvin 102/Beitzah 31b passages. The alternative name form is preserved without resolving a historical identity.
Yonah’s abbreviated title is rendered R'; the full רב before Nachman is rendered Rav.
